leadText:
A Grand Duke (Japanese: グランデューク Grand Duke) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that debuted in Generation VI. This Trainer class is a title of nobility, granted in the Battle Chateau, and Trainers with this class only appear there. Grand Duke is the highest rank of nobility for males, ranking above . They are the male counterparts of the class.

The male player character may earn the title of Grand Duke by defeating most of the Trainers in the Battle Chateau. In the games, no non-player character possesses this Trainer class.

This Trainer class is a title of nobility, granted in the Battle Chateau, and Trainers with this class only appear there. Grand Duke is the highest rank of nobility for males, ranking above . They are the male counterparts of the class.

The male player character may earn the title of Grand Duke by defeating most of the Trainers in the Battle Chateau. In the games, no non-player character possesses this Trainer class.

==In animation==
 
===Pokémon the Series===
In , Grand Dukes are shown wearing purple capes as a distinction from the other titles.

==== ====
In Breaking Titles at the Chateau!, Grant defeated Viola in a battle at the Battle Chateau, earning himself the title of Grand Duke as his reward.
